name: Celadon Sewers & Boss Giovanni
summary: Team up with Gym Leader Erika to infiltrate Team Rocket's subterranean hideout in the Celadon Sewers. Defeat Rocket grunts patrolling the toxic waterways and confront Boss Giovanni. Overcoming Giovanni secures the vital Silph Scope and frees Erika to return to her gym.

items.name: Silph Scope
items.method: Obtained from Boss Giovanni upon his defeat in the sewer command center

items.name: TM34 Sludge Wave
items.method: Inside the narrow pipe tunnel on the lower sewer ground

items.name: Black Sludge
items.method: On higher ground past the three-plank wooden bridge

items.name: Full Restore
items.method: Near Rocket Grunt Max on the upper catwalk

Interactive Trash Can.name: Gloom/Ekans
Interactive Trash Can.rates: Random trashcan encounter (only one can be found)
